InboxMessages.Title: Unlocking Sally
InboxMessages.Message:
Greetings Valley Villager!

With the release of update 14, you can now unlock Sally from Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas for your Village!

A few helpful hints to find Halloween Town's favorite rag doll:
- Unlock Jack Skellington in your Valley. Keep an eye out for Matryoshka Dolls...
- Once you've unlocked Jack Skellington, make sure you've also finished Mirabel's first quest, and have unlocked a sweet and sassy racer.
- You may also need to tie up some "Odds & Ends" in a quest with Merlin.
- Keep an eye out for spiderwebs!

Good luck!

InboxMessages.Title: Community Challenge Rewards
InboxMessages.Message:
Hey Valley Villager!

Back in 2022, the Disney Dreamlight Valley Community banded together to complete all 5 of our Follower and Wishlist goals in our Community Challenge. Each goal was accompanied by a reward, many of which have already been included in the Valley, such as Villager and House Dream Styles, and Valley Visits.

We're happy to deliver two more rewards to all players today: the much anticipated Dreamlight Armor and the Partners Statue! These items will also be available at Scrooge McDuck's Store for all players to acquire.

Thank you to all who participated and we look forward to the production of the last reward, a community-designed animal companion, in the future!

Happy holidays and see you in the Valley!

InboxMessages.Title: Eggstravaganza
InboxMessages.Message:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Get ready to celebrate the arrival of spring with our Eggstravaganza event!

From April 2 through April 22, you'll have the opportunity to find all kinds of bright-colored eggs. (Search everywhere in the Valley AND in Realms you've unlocked!) These will help you earn exclusive rewards!

You'll also complete daily missions with WALL·E for even more seasonal prizes!

Let's make this a spring to remember, full of joy and fun. Happy egg hunting, Valley Villagers!

InboxMessages.Title: A Squirrely Situation...
InboxMessages.Message:
Due to an issue with the Mirabel Parks Event quest, players may find it difficult to unlock the Dug Popcorn Bucket in the time intended.

To help with the issue, we've unlocked the crafting recipe for the Dug Popcorn Bucket furniture for all players, allowing you to craft the Dug Popcorn Bucket without completing the quest if you'd prefer! (Completing the quest will also still earn you a Dug Popcorn Bucket!)

We've included some extra Parks buttons to help get you started.

Good luck, and happy crafting!
